notes: This is an EXAMPLE. Copy it to scripts/disclosure.local.json, which is git-ignored,
and replace the placeholders with the real tokens that must never reach a published file.
Keeping the real list out of git means the repository itself never restates the very
words it is meant to hide.
scripts/check_public_disclosure.py additionally derives the repository owner from the
git remote, so the personal-account rule is enforced even on a clean checkout.
